About

Sebastian Fernandez Rotondaro is a Venezuelan multidisciplinary artist based in Berlin, where he is currently completing a two-year filmmaking course. His journey into moving images began when he came across his camera in a second-hand shop. That camera would later become his loyal companion.

Music has been central to Sebastian’s background, but he has always felt a strong connection to the visual arts. After arriving in Berlin, he started an experimental music project under his high-school nickname “Filo.” The project gradually grew into a blend of music and video, prompting him to take filmmaking more seriously. He is especially interested in creating a responsive relationship between sound and moving images.

He is committed to creating more work through analogue processes as an act of resistance to AI-generated and generic content.
